_meta.label: Solid Protocol
_meta.summary: Decentralized CDP stablecoin protocol on Terra. Issues SOLID (stablecoin); CAPA is the governance/utility token; ampCAPA is the Eris-amplified CAPA LST. Also operates the Atrium NFT marketplace and DeFi games.

facts.claim: SOLID is a decentralized stablecoin (CDP-backed) issued by Solid Protocol, targeting a 1:1 USD peg. In our pricing it should read near $1.00 across sources.
facts.notes: Observed SOLID ~$1.00-1.008 across 4 sources, grade 100. Canonical doc link to confirm.

facts.claim: CAPA is Solid Protocol's governance/utility token. ampCAPA is the Eris-amplified (auto-compounding) version of CAPA, with its own hub exchange rate.
ampCAPA's current on-chain hub exchange rate (CAPA per ampCAPA).
facts.notes: ampCAPA uses the Eris Amplifier mechanism; ratio rises with CAPA staking yield. Never hardcode.

facts.claim: Solid Protocol operates the Atrium NFT marketplace (a sub-product), plus DeFi games, within the aDAO ecosystem.

SOLID is an overcollateralized soft-pegged CDP stablecoin: deposit LSD collateral (whitepaper initial list: LunaX, ampLuna, bLuna, Steak) into per-asset Custody, mint SOLID from Market, LTV_max initially 0.5 (governance-tunable). Liquidation can be partial; liquidation queue takes SOLID bids at 0-30% premium, lowest first; liquidated collateral buys SOLID which is BURNT; 1% liquidator fee to trigger address; oracle prices valid 60s and stale oracle pauses bid execution.

Mint fee known at position open, independent of duration: M(x)=Rbase+(1-x)/2*100 when SOLID<$1 else Rbase (initially 0.5%). Fee split 80% to CAPA stakers (SOLID rewards) / 20% oracles+team, governance-tunable. Below-peg opens get pricier — a supply brake reinforcing the arbitrage peg.

Solid's own Terms of Use (app.solidcapa.com, updated 2026-04-15) state: 'The Protocol's smart contracts have not been formally audited by a third-party security firm.' Combined with SCV+Oak enumeration (no report at either), audit status = NONE, first-party confirmed.
facts.notes: State plainly and neutrally; re-verify if they announce an audit.

facts.claim: Atrium (atrium.markets) is Solid's curated Terra2 NFT marketplace: 5% fee (0% for Cosmic CAPA Crystal holders), fees ~2/3 marketplace treasury + ~1/3 CAPA pool, admin royalties <=15%, admin pause; internal 6-pass audit only (AUDIT.md, github.com/solid-online/atrium-marketplace, 29/29 invariants, 2 medium admin-trust findings). Geo-blocked US/CA/UK/AU/NZ/JP/SG. TRADES THE ALLIANCE NFT COLLECTION and lists 'TLA Locks (veLUNA)' as a collection — vAMP locks are tradeable NFTs, so lock ownership can change hands.
facts.notes: Volume figures on marketplace UI showed internal discrepancy (307.0M vs 307.00 SOLID) — capture volumes from chain, not UI.

facts.claim: CAPA sits in 13 custody forms: liquid CAPA, Solid-gov staked (the ampCAPA hub itself stakes its CAPA there, so the gov contract's balance CONTAINS the hub), ampCAPA liquid, ampCAPA staked plain in the TLA single bucket, the amplified receipt held / staked in the ampCAPA DAO / in its unbonding queue, and CAPA-LUNA LP on Astroport and SkeletonSwap each liquid / TLA-staked plain / amplified. The collection map sums to total supply by guard; per-wallet rows are sum-guarded per form.
facts.notes: Read `status` and `guard_failures` before quoting. `role:"bucket"` rows are structural contracts, not holders; a null form = enumeration incomplete this run, never 0.
